nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used Bayesian linear regression with 5 knot basis splines and sinh-arcsinh warping, implemented via the PCNtoolkit. Age and sex were used as covariates. This approach accounts for non-linear trajectories and non-Gaussian variance of the normal co-localization levels.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The normative modeling was performed using the PCNtoolkit. We modeled the co-localization level (i.e., the Spearman correlation coefficient) derived from spatial correlation analyses between neurotransmitter systems (n = 19) and individual brain functional measures (fALFF, LCOR, and GCOR) of all healthy controls. To account for non-linear trajectories and non-Gaussian variance of the normal co-localization levels, we used Bayesian linear regression (5 knot basis splines and sinh-arcsinh warping) with age and sex as covariates.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Three resting-state fMRI derived measures were used: (1) Fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF) - the power ratio of neuronal activity-related oscillations to the total detectable frequency range in the BOLD signal; (2) Local correlation (LCOR) - BOLD similarity reflecting the voxel's correlation with its local vicinity; (3) Global correlation (GCOR) - BOLD similarity reflecting the voxel's correlation with all other voxels. The normative model was built on the co-localization strength (Fisher's z-transformed Spearman correlation coefficients) between these functional measures and neurotransmitter PET maps.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Three complementary voxelwise maps of brain function, including measures of neuronal activity and synchronicity, were derived from individual, preprocessed rs-fMRI data. Fractional amplitude of low-frequency fluctuations (fALFF) was computed as the power ratio of neuronal activity-related oscillations to the total detectable frequency range in the BOLD signal. Local correlation (LCOR) and global correlation (GCOR) characterized BOLD similarity, reflecting the voxel's correlation either with its local vicinity or with all other voxels, respectively.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were included as covariates in the normative models.
